title: Infinity Player PC v1.5.5
changelog: Cloud Auth & In-Player Developer Control: Live Brevo email OTP delivery, In-Player Developer Control Center (F12) to view and manage all registered users, instant block/unblock controls, subscription plan manager, license days extender, and offline developer authentication fallback.

android.title: Infinity Player Android Beta 0.27.5
android.changelog: Fixed AudioVault auto-logout with silent session recovery and continuous streaming reconnect; added debounced rapid-seek controls (+/-10s) and click protection; restored YouTube Favorites hierarchy with Saved Playlists and Favorite Categories.
